note: Seven audited light/dark palettes. Every pair is checked at build time; a palette below the contrast floor is rejected.

palettes.name: moss-clay
palettes.label: Moss & clay
palettes.note: Grounded and botanical. Warm paper, deep green, terracotta accent.

palettes.name: spruce-coral
palettes.label: Spruce & coral
palettes.note: Cool forest green with a warm signal accent. Good for climate and care products.

palettes.name: cobalt-mint
palettes.label: Cobalt & mint
palettes.note: Clear and technical without falling back to default blue-on-white.

palettes.name: plum-gold
palettes.label: Plum & gold
palettes.note: Editorial and confident. Suits culture, publishing and premium services.

palettes.name: slate-sky
palettes.label: Slate & sky
palettes.note: Calm infrastructure palette. Blue-grey brand, amber accent.

palettes.name: clay-cream
palettes.label: Clay & cream
palettes.note: Earthy and tactile. Terracotta brand with an olive accent.

palettes.name: midnight-rose
palettes.label: Midnight & rose
palettes.note: Expressive contrast. Deep rose brand, indigo accent, soft ink on dark.
